title: Ricky Pearsall injury update: 49ers wide receiver out for 2026 season

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Ricky Pearsall injury update: 49ers wide receiver out for 2026 season
sources.description: The San Francisco 49ers will be without wide receiver Ricky Pearsall for the 2026 season. He was placed on season-ending IR.
